claim_boundary: This report measures full-cache and demo-field completeness. It does not validate scientific accuracy, spatial representativeness or comparability, and it never promotes demo metrics to full-source claims.

findings.detail: Every executable source has a uniform full-population numerator/denominator.
findings.next_action: Run adapters over verified full caches and emit per-field non-null, valid and missing-reason counts.

findings.detail: These executable sources have no checked-in candidate full-population audit.
findings.next_action: Add immutable full-source audits without substituting demo rows.

population_definitions.demo_fixture: Deterministic selected rows for engineering tests; never a full-population denominator.
population_definitions.full_population: Uniform field counts produced by parsing every target-bearing observation in a verified full cache; candidate audits remain separate supporting evidence.
population_definitions.registered_contract: Expected counts in source_manifest.json; not treated as observations by this profile.

automation_health.claim_boundary: Counts describe target observations in one verified source snapshot. Spatial cells are observed cells, not interpolated global coverage; comparable means the minimum declared V4 grouping fields are present.

candidate_audit.warning: The audit proves only its explicit counts and metadata. It does not imply row-level completeness for fields whose non-null numerator was not measured.

demo_fixture.warning: This profile describes a deliberately selected fixture, not the full source population.
